integrity: All derivations are self-contained except the bounded-normal continuous spectral functional calculus and the definition of the new invariant. Numerical quadrature is supplementary and does not certify an infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The formula is exact for normal operators with at most two spectral points and a sharp spectral-pair lower certificate for general normal operators; it does not treat nonnormal operators or complete larger spectra. General cubic stability, unitary spectra, and orthogonal unequal-modulus examples are established elsewhere. Independent priority validation has not been performed.
title: Exact two-spectral-point Cartesian radius and its cubic-to-linear angular transition
